model_runs.name: fct_campaign_performance_daily
model_runs.compiled_code:
-- Campaign performance per platform per day, with CTR / CPC / CPM.
-- Grain: one row per platform per campaign per day.
--
-- Ratios are calculated AFTER summing, so they are correct at this grain.
-- Never average these ratios across rows: re-aggregate the base metrics instead
-- (e.g. CTR for a month = sum(clicks) / sum(impressions)).
-- Table: small, pre-aggregated, and the main entry point for BI and AI agents.

with campaign_daily as (
    select
        platform,
        date_day,
        campaign_id,
        max(campaign_name)      as campaign_name,
        currency_code,
        sum(spend)              as spend,
        sum(spend_eur)          as spend_eur,
        sum(impressions)        as impressions,
        sum(clicks)             as clicks
    from `development`.`dbt_chinedu_marts`.`fct_marketing_spend`
    group by platform, date_day, campaign_id, currency_code
)

select
    md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(platform as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_'), '-', coalesce(cast(campaign_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_'), '-', coalesce(cast(date_day as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_'), '-', coalesce(cast(currency_code as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string)) as campaign_performance_id,
    platform,
    date_day,
    campaign_id,
    campaign_name,
    currency_code,
    spend,
    spend_eur,
    impressions,
    clicks,
    -- nullif -> null instead of divide-by-zero when there is no denominator
    cast(clicks / nullif(impressions, 0) as decimal(18, 6))           as ctr,
    cast(spend_eur / nullif(clicks, 0) as decimal(18, 6))             as cpc_eur,
    cast(spend_eur / nullif(impressions, 0) * 1000 as decimal(18, 6)) as cpm_eur
from campaign_daily

-- MERGEs it on marketing_spend_id. A 3-day lookback picks up late restatements.

-- Grain: one row per platform per ad per day.
-- View: cheap to keep, read only by the marts.

with  __dbt__cte__int_facebook_ads__daily as (

-- Facebook daily stats enriched with ad, ad group, campaign and account attributes,
-- renamed to the shared marketing vocabulary.
-- Grain: one row per ad per day. Ephemeral: only used by int_marketing_ads.

select
    'facebook'              as platform,
    s.date_day,
    s.account_id,
    acc.account_name,
    a.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    a.ad_group_id,
    g.ad_group_name,
    s.ad_id,
    a.ad_name,
    acc.currency_code,
    s.spend,
    s.impressions,
    s.clicks
from `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads__ad_stats` as s
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads__ads` as a
    on s.ad_id = a.ad_id
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads__ad_groups` as g
    on a.ad_group_id = g.ad_group_id
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads__campaigns` as c
    on a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads__accounts` as acc
    on s.account_id = acc.account_id
),  __dbt__cte__int_snapchat_ads__daily as (

-- Snapchat daily stats rolled up from ad x day x country to ad x day (to match Facebook),
-- enriched with ad, ad group and campaign attributes.
-- Grain: one row per ad per day. Ephemeral: only used by int_marketing_ads.

with daily as (
    select
        ad_id,
        date_day,
        currency_code,
        sum(spend)          as spend,
        sum(impressions)    as impressions,
        sum(clicks)         as clicks
    from `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads__ad_stats`
    group by ad_id, date_day, currency_code
)

select
    'snapchat'              as platform,
    d.date_day,
    c.account_id,
    cast(null as string)    as account_name,   -- Snapchat export has no account names
    g.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    a.ad_group_id,
    g.ad_group_name,
    d.ad_id,
    a.ad_name,
    d.currency_code,
    d.spend,
    d.impressions,
    d.clicks
from daily as d
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads__ads` as a
    on d.ad_id = a.ad_id
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads__ad_groups` as g
    on a.ad_group_id = g.ad_group_id
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads__campaigns` as c
    on g.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
), unioned as (
    select * from __dbt__cte__int_facebook_ads__daily
    union all
    select * from __dbt__cte__int_snapchat_ads__daily
)

select
    md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(u.platform as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_'), '-', coalesce(cast(u.ad_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_'), '-', coalesce(cast(u.date_day as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string)) as marketing_spend_id,
    u.platform,
    u.date_day,
    u.account_id,
    u.account_name,
    u.campaign_id,
    u.campaign_name,
    u.ad_group_id,
    u.ad_group_name,
    u.ad_id,
    u.ad_name,
    u.currency_code,
    u.spend,
    cast(u.spend * fx.rate_to_eur as decimal(18, 6)) as spend_eur,
    u.impressions,
    u.clicks
from unioned as u
left join `development`.`dbt_chinedu_reference`.`currency_rates_to_eur` as fx
    on u.currency_code = fx.currency_code
